source_text.body:
Build a full-stack web app with AI and database
A commenter built equimate.app, a working web app with AI integration and a database, using only Replit Agent.
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
What they did
A commenter said they built equimate.app using only Replit Agent. From the thread, the app was a full web app with AI integration and a database, and they drove the agent through the build one prompt at a time rather than coding it manually.
How it went
They described it as complex and fully working. The main downside they named was cost: they said they were about 2,500 prompts in, and another commenter later claimed they found an XSS issue and assorted UI bugs, which the builder disputed.
Worth knowing
The clearest catch was cost and iteration overhead: the builder said it took roughly 2,500 prompts because they had to instruct the agent step by step.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
Build a web app for [purpose, e.g. tracking horse sales] that uses an AI model to [specific AI feature, e.g. summarize or score entries] and stores data in a database. Include user login, a form to add [items], and a page listing them with the AI output. You're done when I can sign up, add an item, and see the AI result saved.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/replit/comments/1kvlmke/has_anyone_been_able_to_actually_create_something
